title: Optimizing Accessibility and Maximum Travel Times in Transit Networks: The Hub Covering Location Problem
summary: This work introduces an optimization model to support decision-making in the design of integrated transit systems, with the aim of improving urban mobility. We assume that daily user trips consist of two types of segments: short segments where users apply their own transport between their homes or workplaces and the public transit access points, and a longer segment on the transportation network.
